map.根据墙体面积和材料类型，估算所需数量和预估成本: By wall area and material type, estimates quantity and cost
map.按墙面净面积与隔音材料幅宽估算用量，结果供下料参考；实际隔声效果取决于系统构造与: Estimates use by net wall area and material width; actual soundproofing depends on system build and seam sealing, not a single material.
map.请选择材料并输入面积后计算: Pick material and enter area to compute
map.临街卧室做隔音，量净墙面积减门窗，按隔音毡幅宽（如 1m×10m）算卷数并加损耗: For a street-side bedroom, measure net wall area minus openings, by mat width (e.g. 1m x 10m) for rolls plus waste.
map.吊顶空腔铺吸音棉，按龙骨分格估算体积与片数，关注防火等级。: For ceiling cavity, lay absorption wool by batten grid for volume and pieces, watch fire rating.
map.对比『单层毡』与『棉+石膏板空腔』两种构造的用量与隔声增量，做性价比选择。: Compare single mat vs wool + gypsum cavity for quantity and sound gain, pick by value.
map.墙面 16㎡，毡 1.0m×10m=10㎡/卷\n需 16×1.05=16.8㎡:
Wall 16 m2, mat 1.0m x 10m = 10 m2/roll
Need 16 x 1.05 = 16.8 m2 -> ~2 rolls
map.不能。隔声是『质量+阻尼+空腔+密封』系统，缝隙漏声会大幅削弱；本工具只算材料量: No. Isolation is a mass + damping + cavity + seal system; seam leakage weakens greatly; this tool only counts material.
map.棉偏吸音降混响、毡偏增加面密度阻隔传声；常配合使用，按目标选。: Wool leans absorption/less reverberation; mat leans mass to block transmission; often combined, pick by goal.
map.要。吊顶/墙体填充材料须达相应燃烧等级（如 A 级不燃），尤其公共与高层空间。: Yes. Filled materials must meet the combustion grade (e.g. A non-combustible), especially public and high-rise.
map.按需隔音的墙面/顶面面积与材料幅宽估算隔音毡、吸音棉用量，辅助下料。: By wall/ceiling area and material width, estimates barrier mat and absorption wool for cutting.
